integrity: A symbolic module identity gives an explicit Gray-weight-2 codeword. An independent exact reconstruction verifies binary ranks 29 and 20, full cross-orthogonality, hull dimension 1, absence of weight-1 words, and all 2^20 words of the displayed dual.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the dual generator printed in Example 5.9. A different intended generator could define a different code, and the result does not rule out the advertised EAQECC parameters from another construction.
title: A weight-two word in the displayed dual of Example 5.9
